lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ሚካኤል ረዳኢ /2/ እሀ እሀ
ናይ እግዚአብሔር ልኡኽ
ረዳኢ ድኹም
[[/chorus]]

ነዓና ተማልድ ንደቂ ሰባት ሚካኤል
ጸሎት ተቕርብ ንጹህ መስዋእቲ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ስርየት ኅድገት ኃጢኣት ንኽንረክብ ጽድቅ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ሕያዋይ ኣቦ ኢኻ ረዳኢ ብሓቂ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]

ብቕጽበት ትመጽእ ካብ ሰማያት ሚካኤል
ኣብ ምድሪ ትበጽሕ ንምሕረት [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ሽግር እትቕይር ናብ ፍጹም ሓጎስ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ስምካ ንዝጽውዕ እትወሓስ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]

ኦ ሚካኤል መልኣኽ ለዋህ ኢኻ ሚካኤል
ነቲ ምስኪን ድኻ ዝረዳእኻ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ነቲ ደብዳቤ ሞት መርዓ ዝቐየርካ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
ሕይወትና ቀይሮ ሎሚ ብጸሎትካ [[highlight]]ሚካኤል[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Mikaʾel redaʾi /2/ ʾiha ʾiha
Nay Egziabher liʾukh
Redaʾi dikhum
[[/chorus]]

Neʿana temald nideqi sebat Mikaʾel
Tselot teqhrib nitsuh meswaʾiti [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Siryet hidget hat'iʾat nikhnirekb tsidq [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Hiyaway ʾabo ʾikha redaʾi bihaqi [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]

Biqhtsibet timetsʾi kab semayat Mikaʾel
ʾAb midri tibetsh nimhiret [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Shigr ʾitqhiyr nab fitsum hagos [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Simka niztsiwʿi ʾitwehas [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]

ʾO Mikaʾel melʾakh lewah ʾikha Mikaʾel
Neti miskin dikha ziredaʾikha [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Neti debdabe mot merʿa ziqheyerka [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
Hiywetna qeyro lomi bitselotka [[highlight]]Mikaʾel[[/highlight]]
